task.title: Implement assistant session and transcript store
task.summary_zh: 建立 assistant session/transcript store，保存 mode actor TTL reason context_pack_id provider_run_id source refs 與 SSE transcript。
acceptance: sessions carry mode actor roles reason TTL status and audit refs
transcripts record user assistant context and provider refs
kernel sessions require reason TTL and capability
expired or revoked sessions reject new messages
tests cover create expire revoke and readback
